description: Source code for MCP9600 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, data structures, initialization, and data fetching functions.

methods.name: mcp9600_reg_read
methods.description: Reads data from MCP9600 register via I2C.

methods.name: mcp9600_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches temperature sample from MCP9600 sensor.

methods.name: mcp9600_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature value as a sensor_value.

methods.name: mcp9600_init
methods.description: Initializes the MCP9600 device, checks I2C bus readiness.
